surfaces.label: First-party executable code and agent workflow
surfaces.notes: Independent auditor fully reviewed every engine and harness source file and all workflow cards. No supported malware, credential harvesting, persistence, covert upload or shell injection found. JSON is parsed as data; subprocesses use fixed argv. User CLI paths retain operator authority.

surfaces.label: Imported GLB resource loading
surfaces.notes: One low-severity source-validated external-resource request issue. Baseline low and focused medium observations share same control; reconciled to low due metadata-only demonstrated impact and browser restrictions.

surfaces.label: Renderer sandbox default
surfaces.notes: All three launches omit chromiumSandbox:true; official Playwright BrowserType.launch docs confirm false default. Contrary to SECURITY.md claim; fix before local integration. No standalone browser exploit proven.

surfaces.label: Setup and publication
surfaces.notes: Avoid upstream setup.sh: unpinned deps, npm lifecycle scripts, system pip --break-system-packages. Use isolated runtime. Publisher not automatically invoked; explicit caller consent required and CC0 written before POST; disable in installed integration unless separately authorized.

surfaces.label: Local HTTP confinement and HTML escaping
surfaces.notes: All servers bind loopback/port 0. Hero/silhouette fixed routes. Judge lexical containment + extension allowlist; no proven independent privilege gain from broad roots/symlink behavior. Narrow installed copy. Display strings escaped, model base64, labels textContent.

surfaces.label: Source inventory and bundled assets
surfaces.notes: 52 tracked regular files, no submodules/symlinks/hooks/compiled executables. Bundle partial review found normal Three.js r180 loaders, no obvious malicious payload. Bundle SHA256 6e1f3d3b6cc6f84a84e11479ce00272c065014818509da595512ece82a463bfa. JSON fixtures parsed as data; no code-execution sink established.

surfaces.label: Installer, publication, delivery, and renderer entry points
